prompt:
Photograph of a Spanish treasure galleon of about 1600 with a broad
hull, a high wooden stern rising three decks, its flat planked transom
painted with saints and quarter galleries, a lower raised bow deck and a
long, low beakhead: square courses and topsails on the fore and main
masts, a lateen mizzen, two square sails on the bowsprit, an ochre and
dark red hull with gilded trim and gun ports, under sail at sea, seen
from low over the water, her bow to the left and a little towards us, a
blue sea with white crests and the open sea running to the horizon all
round her and a sky of soft even blue with a few white clouds, a natural
photograph with no frame, no border and no circle. Historical
reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic. The whole ship is built
of planked wood: no tower, nothing of stone.
